boundary_notice.zh: 临时粗略边界 / 低置信 / 非官方；所有落位、面积与比例须在官方 polygon 到位后整体复算。
boundary_notice.en: Provisional rough boundary / low confidence / non-official; recompute all locations, areas, and ratios when official polygons arrive.

brand.promise_zh: 机器不确定时，先保留两条可人工办理的路。
brand.promise_en: When the machine is uncertain, keep two human-service paths open.
brand.mark_description_zh: 两条平行轨线在人工复核门前保持分离；中间空隙是不得被机器越过的人类决定区。
brand.mark_description_en: Two parallel rails remain separate at a human-review gate; the gap is a decision zone the machine may not cross.

rules.zh: 主色：深海军蓝；公共连续路径：薄荷绿；人工 HOLD/RETURN：珊瑚红。
rules.en: Primary navy; mint for continuous public service; coral for human HOLD/RETURN.

rules.zh: 标志不得合拢两条轨线，不得加入人脸、指纹、眼睛或身份卡图形。
rules.en: Never join the two rails or add face, fingerprint, eye, or identity-card symbols.

rules.zh: 中文名与英文名等权锁定；最小留白等于两条轨线间距。
rules.en: Lock Chinese and English names at equal rank; minimum clear space equals the rail gap.

positions.zh: 百年京张文化带：用铁路转辙而非身份识别讲述可逆选择。
positions.en: Centennial Jing-Zhang Cultural Belt: use railway switching, not identity recognition, to narrate reversible choice.

positions.zh: 都市 AI 生活体验带：把普通人工服务连续性做成可见公共界面。
positions.en: Metropolitan AI Life Experience Belt: make ordinary human-service continuity a visible civic interface.

positions.zh: AI 融合创新带：把误并、离线与供应商退出变成合成测试任务。
positions.en: AI Fusion Innovation Belt: turn false merges, offline sources, and vendor exit into synthetic test tasks.

functions.zh: AI 全栈自主创新体系
functions.move_zh: 公开合成病例、可移植分线协议与人工复核接口
functions.move_en: Open synthetic cases, portable separation protocols, and human-review interfaces

functions.zh: 世界级 AI 创新生态
functions.move_zh: 隐私工程、档案责任、无障碍、服务设计与红队协作
functions.move_en: Privacy engineering, records stewardship, accessibility, service design, and red-team collaboration

functions.move_zh: 三类产业验证与十张公共任务场景卡
functions.move_en: Three industry validations and ten public-task scenario cards

functions.zh: 智能化 AI 活力城市
functions.move_zh: 两条本地服务路、私密拆分间、纸面与电话后备
functions.move_en: Two local service paths, a private separation room, and paper/telephone fallback

functions.move_zh: 发布去标识回执、失败条件与可撤协议，不发布个人轨迹
functions.move_en: Publish de-identified receipts, failure conditions, and revocable protocols—not personal trails

areas_wings.zh: 众智园：合成误并压力测试与标准治理展示
areas_wings.en: Zhongzhiyuan: synthetic false-merge stress tests and standards-governance display

areas_wings.zh: AI 原点社区：双端核源、无障碍共创与纸面流程编排
areas_wings.en: AI Origin Community: two-sided provenance, accessibility co-design, and paper workflow composition

areas_wings.zh: 大钟寺：下游回执、事项决定与普通服务连续演练
areas_wings.en: Dazhongsi: downstream receipts, matter decisions, and ordinary-service continuity rehearsals

areas_wings.zh: 中关村科技服务翼：输出开源测试包、责任模板与专业复核清单
areas_wings.en: Zhongguancun Technology Service Wing: distribute open test packs, responsibility templates, and professional review checklists

areas_wings.zh: 小月河场景赋能翼：验证非识别慢行、无障碍到达和公共解释
areas_wings.en: Xiaoyuehe Scenario Empowerment Wing: validate non-identifying mobility, accessible arrival, and public explanation

case_lenses.zh: 加拿大自动化决策指令与算法影响评估
case_lenses.en: Canada Directive on Automated Decision-Making and Algorithmic Impact Assessment
case_lenses.transfer_zh: 把影响分级、人工干预和公开说明转译为上线前 gate；不证明本地合规。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Translate impact tiers, human intervention, and public explanation into pre-launch gates; not proof of local compliance.

case_lenses.zh: 英国算法透明度记录标准
case_lenses.transfer_zh: 把系统目的、责任人、数据与风险写成可读记录；不替代来源责任。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Record purpose, owner, data, and risks in a readable form; never replace source accountability.

case_lenses.transfer_zh: 借鉴公共可发现性与主管机构字段；不公开个人纠错轨迹。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Borrow public discoverability and authority fields; never publish personal correction trails.

case_lenses.zh: 赫尔辛基 AI 登记册
case_lenses.transfer_zh: 借鉴服务级透明说明与公众反馈入口；不声称等同城市条件。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Borrow service-level explanations and public feedback entry points; do not claim equivalent city conditions.

case_lenses.zh: 欧盟 AI 监管框架公共说明
case_lenses.en: European Commission AI regulatory framework overview
case_lenses.transfer_zh: 用风险分层提醒高影响服务需要更强审查；不作个案法律意见。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Use risk tiers to flag stronger review for high-impact services; not case-specific legal advice.

industry_tests.zh: 共享联系方式碰撞测试
industry_tests.input_zh: 合成同名、同生日、家庭共用电话与转写记录
industry_tests.input_en: Synthetic same-name, birthday, household-phone, and transliteration records
industry_tests.human_zh: 隐私/档案专业者批准摘要字段；来源责任人只核本端。
industry_tests.human_en: Privacy/records professional approves summary fields; each source owner checks only its side.
industry_tests.fail_zh: 泄露另一人资料、要求新增生物识别或不能冻结链接即 RETURN。
industry_tests.fail_en: RETURN if the other person's data leaks, biometrics are added, or the link cannot be frozen.

industry_tests.zh: 下游不利动作传播测试
industry_tests.input_zh: 合成预约、材料缺口或风险提示已传播到四个接收点
industry_tests.input_en: Synthetic appointment, missing-document, or risk flag propagated to four recipients
industry_tests.human_zh: 事项专业责任人逐项判断是否撤回、纠正或保留争议。
industry_tests.human_en: Matter owner decides item by item whether to withdraw, correct, or keep disputed.
industry_tests.fail_zh: 未闭环接收点不得显示完成；基本服务继续，争议事项 HOLD。
industry_tests.fail_en: No completion while a recipient remains open; basic service continues and the disputed matter stays HOLD.

industry_tests.zh: 离线与供应商退出测试
industry_tests.input_zh: 一个来源机构离线、供应商停止服务、AI 工具关闭
industry_tests.input_en: One source offline, vendor service ended, and AI tool switched off
industry_tests.human_zh: 公共服务责任人启动纸面/电话路径；数据责任人签署退出交接。
industry_tests.human_en: Public-service owner activates paper/telephone paths; data steward signs the exit handover.
industry_tests.fail_zh: 两人的普通服务同时消失或开放清单无人接手即停止试点。
industry_tests.fail_en: Stop the pilot if ordinary service disappears for both people or no one accepts the open list.

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 本人提出；前厅只登记最小请求
scenario_cards.decision_en: Person raises it; desk logs only the minimum request

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 数据责任人批准冻结新自动动作
scenario_cards.decision_en: Data steward approves freezing new automated actions

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 各责任人只核本端原始记录
scenario_cards.decision_en: Each owner checks only its source record

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 隐私专业者批准可见字段
独立复核人决定拆分或保持分离
scenario_cards.decision_en: Independent reviewer decides split or continued separation

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 每个事项责任人逐项关闭
scenario_cards.decision_en: Each matter owner closes its own item

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 本人确认原意，语言责任人确认译文
scenario_cards.decision_en: Person confirms intent; language owner confirms translation

scenario_cards.carrier_en: Low counter and quiet waiting seat
scenario_cards.decision_zh: 无障碍专业者确认等价路径
scenario_cards.ai_zh: 提示可选辅助，不强制数字入口
scenario_cards.ai_en: Offer optional aids without forcing digital entry

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 数据责任人与公共服务责任人共同签收
scenario_cards.decision_en: Data and public-service owners co-sign handover

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 专业评审决定是否继续有限演示
scenario_cards.decision_en: Professional panel decides whether bounded demonstration continues

landmarks.purpose_zh: 以两条不相交触感导带解释默认分离；不识别人。
landmarks.purpose_en: Two non-joining tactile rails explain default separation; no person recognition.

landmarks.purpose_zh: 只显示本地办理、人工复核、HOLD、关闭四种中性状态。
landmarks.purpose_en: Displays only four neutral states: local service, human review, HOLD, closed.

landmarks.purpose_zh: 只显示去标识闭环数量和未闭环数量，不显示姓名或事项。
landmarks.purpose_en: Shows only de-identified closed/open counts, never names or matters.

operations.owner_zh: 独立测试主持 + 隐私/档案专业者
operations.gate_zh: 测试包、权利说明、无真实数据
operations.gate_en: Test pack, rights note, no real data
operations.exit_zh: 发现泄露或生物识别升级即撤下病例
operations.exit_en: Withdraw case on leakage or biometric escalation

operations.owner_zh: 公共服务责任人 + 无障碍代表
operations.gate_zh: 人工、纸面、电话路径均可演示
operations.gate_en: Human, paper, and telephone paths demonstrable
operations.exit_zh: 任一群体无等价路径则 HOLD
operations.exit_en: HOLD if any group lacks an equivalent path

operations.zh: 可撤 AI 城市协议论坛
operations.owner_zh: 任务书运营团队建议角色 + 独立专业评审
operations.owner_en: Proposed taskbook operations role + independent professional panel
operations.gate_zh: 只发布方法、合成结果和失败条件
operations.gate_en: Publish methods, synthetic results, and failure conditions only
operations.exit_zh: 不得把活动写成政府已确定安排
operations.exit_en: Never present the event as a confirmed government programme

operations.owner_zh: 贡献者本人授权 + 社区维护者
operations.gate_zh: 只展示自愿署名的方法/组件，不展示个人服务记录
operations.gate_en: Display voluntarily credited methods/components, never personal service records
operations.exit_zh: 撤回授权后移除署名但保留版本事实
operations.exit_en: Remove credit after withdrawal while preserving version facts

implementation.evidence_zh: 服务清单、来源责任、权利台账
implementation.evidence_en: Service list, source ownership, rights ledger
Eight synthetic pairs and failure log

implementation.owner_zh: 隐私/档案/无障碍/消防/信息安全专业者
implementation.owner_en: Privacy, records, accessibility, fire, and information-security professionals

implementation.owner_zh: 场地与公共服务责任人
implementation.evidence_zh: 容量、等候、语言、人工后备回执
implementation.evidence_en: Capacity, waiting, language, and human-fallback receipts

implementation.owner_zh: 数据责任人与公共服务责任人
implementation.evidence_zh: 开放清单、删除/保留依据、普通服务恢复
implementation.evidence_en: Open list, deletion/retention basis, ordinary-service restoration
